topic: SS Ohio: the tanker brought into Malta between warships
centralQuestion: How did a disabled tanker reach Malta, and why did its cargo matter?
thesis: A changing team of escorts and local vessels brought a badly damaged tanker to Malta so its fuel could be delivered.
viewerPayoff: Understand the side-by-side assistance and why delivering the surviving fuel mattered more than recovering a working ship.
